Subject: Final signing playbook & notary exception

Tom —

Thanks again for working through the MSA redlines this week. Attached are: Redwood_MSA_v3.2_clean.pdf (clean final), Redwood_MSA_v3.2_redline.pdf (our last pass) and OrderForm_ACME_v2.docx. Before we pull the DocuSign envelope together I want to confirm a couple of practical items so we don't get delayed at execution:

1) Signers & authority: please confirm the exact name, title and email for each ACME signer (legal and finance). If the CFO will sign, we need either a recent board resolution or a POA confirming signing authority.

2) Notarization: you flagged the request for notarization on the call. We can accommodate in-person/notary if ACME prefers, but that will add logistics and a 3–5 day window. Alternatively, we can proceed with e-sign only and include a "notary exception" clause in the envelope notes for downstream audit. Which do you prefer?

3) DocuSign sequencing suggestion (proposed):
   - Step 1: ACME Legal (review & initial)
   - Step 2: ACME CFO (signature — require access code)
   - Step 3: Redwood Sales (Marissa Cole) — countersign acceptance
   - Step 4: Redwood Ops/Finance final countersign (we usually have Priyom or Karthik countersign depending on availability)

If you want Redwood to countersign last, confirm who on your side should sign first so we set the routing accordingly.

Timing: we'd like to send the envelope on Tue, 7 Aug (your suggested week). If you confirm signers & POA by EOD Monday (6 Aug) we can meet that schedule.

Attached: MSA (clean + redline) and draft order form.

Thanks,

—Priyom Das
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
